_comment: QY100 pattern-effect (variation/insertion effect) type selector, discovered and verified 2026-08-11. See ../CLAUDE.md ('Remote control over MIDI') for the full writeup and how this was captured.
message_format: F0 43 1n 4C aa bb cc dd [ee] F7 -- standard Yamaha XG Parameter Change, not the QY100-model-specific 5F protocol qy100-syx decodes. n = device number (0 here). aa bb cc = 3-byte address. Remaining bytes = data.
description: Selects the pattern's effect type (reverb/delay/chorus/insertion family, shown on the QY100's FX screen). Data is 2 bytes: MSB = effect family, LSB = variant within that family.
verified_bidirectional_note: The QY100 transmits this message when you change the effect type from the panel, AND accepts it as a remote command: sending the exact same bytes back over MIDI IN changes the effect type on screen. Confirmed live 2026-08-11 -- sent '02 01 40 06 00' and watched the display change to 'Delay L,R'; separately sent '02 01 40 08 00' (Cross Delay) while the device was NOT on the FX screen at all, and it still took effect. So this isn't gated on which screen is currently open -- it's a live parameter of the sounding pattern, settable at any time regardless of panel state.
lsb_pattern_note: LSB is not always a plain sequential count. Hall/Room/Stage/ER go 00,01[,02]. Chorus and Celeste go 00,01,02,08 (jump to 08 for variant 4). Flanger goes 00,01,08. Phaser goes 00,08. This is the real address-space layout, not a transcription simplification -- re-verify rather than assuming a pattern for untested families.
not_yet_mapped: Everything outside address 02 01 40 -- e.g. effect depth/parameters, reverb/chorus send levels (those are plain CC91/CC93, not SysEx -- see CLAUDE.md), voice/program per part, pan, and anything under the 00 00 xx / 08 xx yy system- and job-level addresses seen during the Undo/Redo capture, which have not been individually decoded yet.
